main_text.l: affigere loco excelso, vertiginosus esset illius
stupor, qui Papam perinde improbum,
sed humi projectum exutumque imperio, titulo
sanctitatis vestiret.
Denique is est Papa à quo manant multa
ἀσύστατα, contraria, pugnantia, & invicem
dissidentia, impietas cum sanctitate juncta,
vita Simoniâ infamis, libidinibus diffluens,
cum fide orthodoxa, Tyrannis superba illius
qui pedem porrigit osculandum Imperatori-
bus, nemini mortalium assurgit, & regna
adimit, cum humilitate illius qui lavat pedes
pauperum, & se vocat servum servorum Dei:
nam eadem propemodum verba loquitur Cor-
nelius Agrippa. Ipse Romanus Pontifex om-

facere, aut recipere, juxta Symmachum Pa-
pam; qui vult Petrum perennem meritorum
dotem transmisisse ad posteros, quis enim sanc-

l.i: tum dubitet esse quem apex tantæ dignitatis attollit?

main_text.l: sed bone Deus quos sanctos habuit se-
des Petri, nono & decimo seculo; cum teste
Genebrardo per annos circiter centum & quin-

page.notes: The left margin notes are placed by their lines: "De vanit. scientiar. c. 61." beside "nelius Agrippa"; "Dist. 40. can. rex nos." beside "dotem transmisisse". The Greek word "ἀσύστατα" is uncertain (printed as ἀούσατα); the reading "rex" in the note is doubtful. The bottom-right word is a catchword, read as "sum". The running head is treated as "Jugulum Causæ." with "Cap. 10." kept as printed.
